title: Painting Contractor in Newberry, FL | Local Crews
description: Newberry, FL is our home base. Painting contractor for downtown historic homes, Country Way, Newberry Oaks, Arbor Greens, and new builds. Free written quotes.
heroIntro: Newberry is where Precision Paint Experts is based. We paint the restored homes near downtown, the new subdivisions growing toward Town of Tioga, and the businesses in between.

body: Most contractors treat Newberry as a stop on the way to somewhere else. For us it is the starting point. Precision Paint Experts is locally owned and based in Newberry, FL 32669, and our crews bring more than 15 years of painting experience to the town's homes and businesses.

Being close means short drive times for walkthroughs, an easy return trip if a door needs another look, and a crew lead who already knows how Newberry's new and old houses behave. We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member, and we do not subcontract the work.

Newberry is growing quickly on Gainesville's western edge, and its housing reflects that. Near Downtown Newberry and the West End, restored historic homes need patient prep: older wood, multiple paint layers, and trim details that are worth preserving instead of covering up with a quick spray coat.

Further out, large new-construction subdivisions stretch toward Town of Tioga. Homes in Country Way, Newberry Oaks, and Arbor Greens usually need less repair, but builder-grade finishes on walls and trim often look tired within a few years. Owners want washable walls, cleaner trim lines, and colors they chose themselves, often within community guidelines.

sections.h2: Sun, damp, and growth: Newberry's paint problems
body: Newberry sits in the same subtropical belt as the rest of North Central Florida. Mildew and algae grow on anything that stays damp, and sprinklers make sure some walls always are. Newer homes whose landscaping has not grown in yet take full afternoon sun on the west side, so pigment fades and paint chalks faster than on shaded walls. Caulk joints on new houses dry out and open as the building settles.

Our answer is preparation more than paint: washing and mildew treatment, flexible re-caulking, spot-priming, and then two full coats of premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore. Read our North Central Florida exterior care guide for maintenance between repaints.

sections.h2: What working with us looks like
body: Call (386) 854-7139 or request a quote online, and a crew lead will usually walk your property within 48 hours. They measure, photograph conditions, and take moisture readings where needed. An itemized written estimate follows, usually within a business day, listing surfaces, prep, products, coats, and schedule.

Most jobs start one to three weeks after approval. You can stay home throughout; crews protect furniture and work room by room. The project ends with a punch walk you sign, labelled touch-up paint, and a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exteriors.
From Newberry we also serve Gainesville, Archer, Alachua, and High Springs, plus Trenton and Williston just across the county lines.

faqs.q: Is Precision Paint Experts actually based in Newberry?
faqs.a: Yes. The company is locally owned and based in Newberry, FL 32669, and serves Alachua County and four neighboring counties.

faqs.q: My Newberry home is only a few years old. Does it need repainting already?
faqs.a: Often the interior does. Builder-grade flat paint scuffs and does not wash well. Exteriors usually last longer, but caulk joints and sun-facing walls should be checked.

faqs.q: Do you work on historic homes near downtown Newberry?
faqs.a: Yes. Older homes get extra scraping, sanding, and priming, and any wood repair is documented and itemized before work starts.
